title: EARLY_SPACING: in the first 30 s, when a known enemy is within 120 m and we are not engaging, pick the farm / arm-up / zone target that keeps us >= 120 m from it (EARLY_SPACING_ON)
behaviors: t < EARLY_SPACING_T (30 s), a known enemy within EARLY_SPACING_M (120 m), not engaging, not in laser rush, drop gate open: among the farm / arm-up / zone targets the champion would consider, pick one that keeps us >= 120 m from that enemy when one exists, else the champion's choice

evidence.source: Mech Watcher ladder (coord/data/findings.md F10): nearest enemy in the first 30 s is 145 m for winners vs 117 m for losers

novelty: P52 (EARLY_FARM_ON) widens the farm reach and gate from 10 to 60 s, picking the nearest cube when every enemy is > 145 m away; it never picks a target BY distance to an enemy. P54 changes only which of the champion's own candidate targets is chosen, in the first 30 s, when an enemy is already within 120 m. The champion has no early-game target rule that scores targets by enemy distance.
step_a: Log only, trees-on on P48: count games where t < 30, a known enemy within 120 m, not engaging / laser rush, drop gate open, and an alternative target keeping >= 120 m exists that differs from the champion's pick, on 2000+3000 and 4000+5000. Fewer than 10/192 on either set: step-a-fail, no build.
what_would_disprove: No rise in our early (t < 30 s) nearest-enemy distance, or deaths before 40 s up.
drop_gate: Never when a drop is near AND reachable within DROP_RUN_M (champion's drop-run candidate filter) or on a drop run / ring hold. Never 'any drop exists'.
next_action: Mech Builder: build behind EARLY_SPACING_ON (default false), FASTER checklist on bases 0 and 6000.

step_a_result.champion: P48 b9492c6 (merge edb729f; bot files identical on main c2b3e1d), TREE_RETREAT_ON=true
step_a_result.trigger_as_counted: 10 <= t < 30 (opening excluded, checklist item 2), champion's final mode 'hold' or 'heal' (so not engaging, not laser rush, no retreat/zone travel/drop run/hold), an enemy mech in view or seen in the last 10 s within 120 m, drop gate open (no drop passes the drop run's candidate filter: not skipped, holder null or us, within DROP_RUN_M 200 m, zone-safe for lands_in + capture), and an alternative among the champion's targets (rushable laser/lightning per the Build 17 filter with a free slot, zone-safe cube within FARM_PICKUP_M, next-circle entry point when outside it) that is >= 120 m from every such enemy and not toward the nearest one (strict). Champion's pick in hold/heal is no target, so every such alternative differs.
step_a_result.champion_early_spacing: Mean nearest known enemy (in view or seen <= 10 s, bot's own view) over decisions with t < 30, averaged per game: 75.6 / 81.6 / 80.3 / 73.8 m on bases 2000/3000/4000/5000 (about 78.6 m on 2000+3000, 77.0 m on 4000+5000); mean per-game minimum 45.0 / 49.5 / 47.2 / 45.0 m. Not the Watcher's site measure (145 vs 117 m).
step_a_result.passivity: IDENTICAL: every non-timing column (all but late_over_50ms, bot_ms_mean) equals /workspace/tester/runs/trees-b9492c6-<b>.csv on 96/96 games per base (384/384); 0 probe exceptions; log-to-seed order checked on decisions of all games that died before 29.5 s (28/28).
